#!/bin/bash
#
# Copyright 2011 The Chromium Authors
# Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be
# found in the LICENSE file.

# Let the wrapped binary know that it has been run through the wrapper.
export CHROME_WRAPPER="`readlink -f "$0"`"

HERE="`dirname "$CHROME_WRAPPER"`"

# We include some xdg utilities next to the binary, and we want to prefer them
# over the system versions when we know the system versions are very old. We
# detect whether the system xdg utilities are sufficiently new to be likely to
# work for us by looking for xdg-settings. If we find it, we leave $PATH alone,
# so that the system xdg utilities (including any distro patches) will be used.
if ! command -v xdg-settings &> /dev/null; then
  # Old xdg utilities. Prepend $HERE to $PATH to use ours instead.
  export PATH="$HERE:$PATH"
else
  # Use system xdg utilities. But first create mimeapps.list if it doesn't
  # exist; some systems have bugs in xdg-mime that make it fail without it.
  xdg_app_dir="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/applications}"
  mkdir -p "$xdg_app_dir"
  [ -f "$xdg_app_dir/mimeapps.list" ] || touch "$xdg_app_dir/mimeapps.list"
fi

export CHROME_VERSION_EXTRA="stable"

# We don't want bug-buddy intercepting our crashes. http://crbug.com/24120
export GNOME_DISABLE_CRASH_DIALOG=SET_BY_GOOGLE_CHROME

# Sanitize std{in,out,err} because they'll be shared with untrusted child
# processes (http://crbug.com/376567).
exec < /dev/null
exec > >(exec cat)
exec 2> >(exec cat >&2)

# Note: exec -a below is a bashism.
exec -a "$0" "$HERE/chrome" "$@"

CA implementation:

```js
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  // rule obituary: 8 patterns (left,center,right) bits
  const table = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) table[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return table;
}
```
Convention: pattern index p = (left<<2)|(center<<1)|right, and in the standard Wolfram rule, bit = (pattern) where pattern value = left*4 + center*2 + right; rule bit index = pattern value. So table[p] = (rule >> p) & 1. Good.

```js
export function simulateCA({rule, width, height, seedRow}) {
  // returns Uint8Array of width*height, 1 where alive
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [];
  let curr = seedRow !== undefined ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width);
  rows.push(curr);
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = curr[(x-1+width)%width];       // wrap
      const c = curr[x];
      const r = curr[(x+1)%width];
      next[x] = table[(l<<2)|(c<<1)|r];
    }
    rows.push(next); curr = next;
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width*height);
  // grid order: index = g*width + x  (generation g row, x column)
  // texture layout: u = x/width, v = g/height... we want horizontal bars? 
  return data;
}
```

Returns a flat row-major\n// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.\nexport function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {\n  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');\n  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');\n  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);\n  let rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];\n  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {\n    const prev = rows[g - 1];\n    const next = new Uint8Array(width);\n    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {\n      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];\n      const c = prev[x];\n      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];\n      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];\n    }\n    rows.push(next);\n  }\n  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);\n  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);\n  return data;\n}\n\n// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.\nexport function makePatternData(rule, width, height) {\n  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);\n  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);\n  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {\n    rgba[i * 4 + 0] = 255;\n    rgba[i * 4 + 1] = 255;\n    rgba[i * 4 + 2] = 255;\n    rgba[i * 4 + 3] = cells[i] ? 255 : 0;\n  }\n  return rgba;\n}\n\n/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */\n\nexport const CC = {\n  WIDTH: 7,\n  SPEED: 10,\n  BRIGHTNESS: 11,\n};\n\nexport const CC_DEFAULTS = {\n  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,     // cell count\n  [CC.SPEED]: 64,     // normalised\n  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,\n};\n\nexport const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];      // cells\nexport const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];  // multiplier (0.25x .. 2.5x)\nexport const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];  // intensity multiplier\n\nexport function ccWidthCells(v) {\n  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;\n  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));\n}\n\nexport function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {\n  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;\n  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);\n}\n\nexport function ccBrightness(v) {\n  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;\n  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);\n}\n\n/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */\n\nexport function pitchToHue(note) {\n  // Spread notes across the full colour wheel without repeating frequently.\n  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);\n}\n\nexport function pickRandomRule(rng = Math.random) {\n  return CA_RULES[Math.floor(rng() * CA_RULES.length)];\n}\n\nexport function randomSquare(rng = Math.random) {\n  // direction: one axis only, random sign so squares exit the screen in a fair spread\n  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';\n  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;\n  return {\n    axis,\n    sign,\n    horizontal: axis === 'x',\n    // size in screen pixels; independent of canvas size for now\n    baseSize: 60 + rng() * 160,\n    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,   // px/s\n    life: 4 + rng() * 3.5,           // seconds\n    rule: pickRandomRule(rng),\n  };\n}\n\nexport function scaleVelocity(base, speedMultiplier) {\n  return base * speedMultiplier;\n}\n\nexport function scaleSize(base, noteVelocity) {\n  // higher velocity => slightly larger square\n  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;\n  return base * (0.65 + 0.5 * vel);\n}\n\n/* ---------- fade curve ---------- */\n\nexport function squareAlpha(t, life, fadeIn = 0.18, fadeOut = 1.3) {\n  if (t < 0 || t > life) return 0;\n  const aIn = clamp(t / fadeIn, 0, 1);\n  const remain = life - t;\n  const aOut = remain < fadeOut ? clamp(remain / fadeOut, 0, 1) : 1;\n  return aIn * aOut;\n}\n\nexport function clamp(v, lo, hi) {\n  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;\n}\nEOF\nnode --input-type=module -e \"\nimport * as CA from './ca.js';\nconsole.log('rules:', CA.CA_RULES.length);\nconst data = CA.simulateCA(90, 16, 32);\nconsole.log('cells:', data.length, 'alive:', data.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0));\nconst rgba = CA.makePatternData(110, 12, 16);\nconsole.log('texture rgba:', rgba.length, 'alpha0:', rgba[3], 'alpha3:', rgba[15]);\nconsole.log('cc width 0/64/127:', CA.ccWidthCells(0), CA.ccWidthCells(64), CA.ccWidthCells(127));\nconsole.log('cc speed:', CA.ccSpeedMultiplier(0).toFixed(2), CA.ccSpeedMultiplier(64).toFixed(2), CA.ccSpeedMultiplier(127).toFixed(2));\nconsole.log('cc bright:', CA.ccBrightness(0).toFixed(2), CA.ccBrightness(64).toFixed(2), CA.ccBrightness(127).toFixed(2));\nconsole.log('hue(60):', CA.pitchToHue(60).toFixed(3), 'hue(36):', CA.pitchToHue(36).toFixed(3));\nconst s = CA.randomSquare(() => 0.42);\nconsole.log('sq:', JSON.stringify(s));\nconsole.log('velocity(60*multi):', CA.scaleVelocity(50, 2.0).toFixed(1), 'size vel100:', CA.scaleSize(100, 100).toFixed(1));\nconsole.log('alpha t0/mid/out/end:', CA.squareAlpha(0, 5).toFixed(2), CA.squareAlpha(2.5, 5).toFixed(2), CA.squareAlpha(4.6, 5).toFixed(2), CA.squareAlpha(5, 5).toFixed(2));\n\""}

function applyBlendingTo(m, mode) {
  m.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
  m.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
  m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  if (mode === 'normal') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'additive') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'multiply') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 2;
  } else if (mode === 'subtract') {
    m.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else {
    throw new Error('unknown blending mode: ' + mode);
  }
}

/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

export const CA_RULES = [
  90, 110, 150, 60, 73, 99, 135, 45, 22, 3, 5, 21, 51, 17, 103, 61,
];

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }

import {
  CC, CC_DEFAULTS, WIDTH_RANGE,
  makePatternData, ccWidthCells, ccSpeedMultiplier, ccBrightness,
  pitchToHue, clamp, randomSquare, scaleSize, scaleVelocity, squareAlpha,
} from './ca.js';

const TEXTURE_HEIGHT = 96;
const MAX_SQUARES = 40;
const SYSTEM_FPS = 60;

const canvasEl = document.getElementById('canvas');

/* ---------- scene setup ---------- */
let width = window.innerWidth;
let height = window.innerHeight;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: canvasEl, alpha: true, antialias: true, premultipliedAlpha: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
renderer.setSize(width, height);
renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
renderer.autoClear = true;

const camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-width / 2, width / 2, height / 2, -height / 2, 0.1, 10);
camera.position.set(0, 0, 5);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const planeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1);

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const state = {
  cc: { [CC.WIDTH]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.WIDTH], [CC.SPEED]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.SPEED], [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.BRIGHTNESS] },
  blendMode: 'additive',
  autoplay: false,
  lastSpawnAt: 0,
  lastTime: performance.now(),
  squares: [],
  dirtyTextures: false,
};

/* ---------- materials ---------- */
function makeSquareMaterial(hue) {
  const color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(hue, 0.85, 0.62);
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: {
      uPattern: { value: null },
      uColor: { value: color },
      uFade: { value: 1 },
      uIntensity: { value: 1 },
      uMode: { value: 0 },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      uniform sampler2D uPattern;
      uniform vec3 uColor;
      uniform float uFade;
      uniform float uIntensity;
      uniform float uMode;
      void main() {
        vec4 p = texture2D(uPattern, vUv);
        float a = p.a * uFade * uIntensity;
        vec3 rgb;
        if (uMode > 1.5) {
          rgb = mix(vec3(1.0), uColor, clamp(a, 0.0, 1.0));
        } else {
          rgb = uColor * a;
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, a);
      }`,
  });
  return mat;
}

function applyBlendingTo(m, mode) {
  m.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
  m.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
  m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  if (mode === 'normal') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'additive') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'multiply') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 2;
  } else if (mode === 'subtract') {
    m.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else {
    throw new Error('unknown blending mode: ' + mode);
  }
}

function applyBlending(mode) {
  for (const s of state.squares) applyBlendingTo(s.material, mode);
}

/* ---------- square lifecycle ---------- */
function makePatternFor(rule, width) {
  const rgba = makePatternData(rule, width, TEXTURE_HEIGHT);
  const tex = new THREE.DataTexture(rgba, width, TEXTURE_HEIGHT, THREE.RGBAFormat);
  tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
  tex.generateMipmaps = false;
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  return tex;
}

function createSquare({ note, velocity }) {
  const cfg = randomSquare();
  const size = scaleSize(cfg.baseSize, velocity);
  const speedBase = cfg.baseVelocity;
  const hues = pitchToHue(note);

  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const tex = makePatternFor(cfg.rule, w);
  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);
  material.uniforms.uPattern.value = tex;
  material.uniforms.uFade.value = 0;
  material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  applyBlendingTo(material, state.blendMode);

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, material);
  mesh.scale.set(size, size, 1);
  mesh.position.set(
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * width,
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * height,
    0
  );
  mesh.rotation.z = cfg.horizontal ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  mesh.visible = true;

  scene.add(mesh);
  const square = {
    mesh, material, texture: tex,
    axis: cfg.axis, sign: cfg.sign, horizontal: cfg.horizontal,
    size, baseVelocity: speedBase, life: cfg.life, rule: cfg.rule,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

function destroySquare(s) {
  scene.remove(s.mesh);
  s.texture.dispose();
  s.material.dispose();
}

function refreshTexturesForWidth(newWidth) {
  for (const s of state.squares) {
    if (s.widthCells === newWidth) continue;
    const oldTex = s.texture;
    s.texture = makePatternFor(s.rule, newWidth);
    s.material.uniforms.uPattern.value = s.texture;
    s.widthCells = newWidth;
    oldTex.dispose();
  }
}

function clearSquares() {
  for (const s of state.squares) destroySquare(s);
  state.squares = [];
}

/* ---------- animation ---------- */
function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

/* ---------- MIDI ---------- */
let midiAccess = null;
const subscribedInputs = new Set();

function pickRandomNote() {
  return 48 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 48); // C3..C7
}

async function connectMidi() {
  try {
    midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false });
    midiAccess.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribeToMidiInputs();
    setMidiStatus('connected', midiAccess.inputs.size);
  } catch (err) {
    setMidiStatus('unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'not allowed'));
  }
}

function subscribeToMidiInputs() {
  if (!midiAccess) return;
  for (const input of midiAccess.inputs.values()) {
    if (subscribedInputs.has(input)) continue;
    input.onmidimessage = onMidiMessage;
    input.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribedInputs.add(input);
  }
}

function handleMidiStateChange() {
  subscribeToMidiInputs();
  setMidiStatus(midiAccess && midiAccess.inputs.size > 0 ? 'connected' : 'no MIDI inputs', midiAccess ? midiAccess.inputs.size : 0);
}

function onMidiMessage(e) {
  const [status, d1, d2] = e.data;
  const cmd = status & 0xf0;
  const channel = status & 0x0f;

  if (channel === 1) { // channel 2: intentionally idle for now
    setReadout('channel 2 event (idle)');
    return;
  }
  if (channel !== 0) return;

  if (cmd === 0x90 && d2 > 0) { // note on

    const val = clamp(d2, 0, 127);

      if (d1 === CC.WIDTH) state.dirtyTextures = true;
      syncControlsFromState();
      setReadout('CC ' + d1 + ' = ' + val);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- spawning ---------- */
function spawnNote(note, velocity) {
  const square = createSquare({ note, velocity });
  setReadout('note ' + note + ' (v' + velocity + ')');
  return square;
}

/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

export const CA_RULES = [
  90, 110, 150, 60, 73, 99, 135, 45, 22, 3, 5, 21, 51, 17, 103, 61,
];

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);
  return data;
}

// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.
export function makePatternData(rule, width, height) {
  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    rgba[i * 4 + 0] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 1] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 2] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 3] = cells[i] ? 255 : 0;
  }
  return rgba;
}

/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */

export const CC = {
  WIDTH: 7,
  SPEED: 10,
  BRIGHTNESS: 11,
};

export const CC_DEFAULTS = {
  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,
  [CC.SPEED]: 64,
  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,
};

export const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];
export const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];
export const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];

export function ccWidthCells(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;
  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));
}

export function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function pickRandomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return CA_RULES[Math.floor(rng() * CA_RULES.length)];
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSize: 60 + rng() * 160,
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    life: 4 + rng() * 3.5,
    rule: pickRandomRule(rng),
  };
}

export function scaleVelocity(base, speedMultiplier) {
  return base * speedMultiplier;
}

export function scaleSize(base, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return base * (0.65 + 0.5 * vel);
}

/* ---------- fade curve ---------- */

export function squareAlpha(t, life, fadeIn = 0.18, fadeOut = 1.3) {
  if (t < 0 || t > life) return 0;
  const aIn = clamp(t / fadeIn, 0, 1);
  const remain = life - t;
  const aOut = remain < fadeOut ? clamp(remain / fadeOut, 0, 1) : 1;
  return aIn * aOut;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);

  );

}

let midiAccess = null;
const subscribedInputs = new Set();

function pickRandomNote() {
  return 48 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 48); // C3..C7
}

async function connectMidi() {
  try {
    midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false });
    midiAccess.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribeToMidiInputs();
    setMidiStatus('connected', midiAccess.inputs.size);
  } catch (err) {
    setMidiStatus('unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'not allowed'));
  }
}

function subscribeToMidiInputs() {
  if (!midiAccess) return;
  for (const input of midiAccess.inputs.values()) {
    if (subscribedInputs.has(input)) continue;
    input.onmidimessage = onMidiMessage;
    input.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribedInputs.add(input);
  }
}

function handleMidiStateChange() {
  subscribeToMidiInputs();
  setMidiStatus(midiAccess && midiAccess.inputs.size > 0 ? 'connected' : 'no MIDI inputs', midiAccess ? midiAccess.inputs.size : 0);
}

/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

export const CA_RULES = [
  90, 110, 150, 60, 73, 99, 135, 45, 22, 3, 5, 21, 51, 17, 103, 61,
];

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);
  return data;
}

// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.
export function makePatternData(rule, width, height) {
  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    rgba[i * 4 + 0] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 1] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 2] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 3] = cells[i] ? 255 : 0;
  }
  return rgba;
}

/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */

export const CC = {
  WIDTH: 7,
  SPEED: 10,
  BRIGHTNESS: 11,
  SIZE: 14,
};

export const CC_DEFAULTS = {
  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,
  [CC.SPEED]: 64,
  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,
  [CC.SIZE]: 64,
};

export const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];
export const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];
export const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];
export const SIZE_RANGE = [0.25, 4.0];

export function ccWidthCells(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;
  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));
}

export function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Geometric mapping: CC=64 is exactly 1.00x (geometric mean of range).
export function ccScale(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SIZE_RANGE;
  const t = clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127;
  return Math.sqrt(lo * hi) * Math.pow(hi / lo, t - 0.5);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function pickRandomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return CA_RULES[Math.floor(rng() * CA_RULES.length)];
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSize: 60 + rng() * 160,
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    life: 4 + rng() * 3.5,
    rule: pickRandomRule(rng),
  };
}

export function scaleVelocity(base, speedMultiplier) {
  return base * speedMultiplier;
}

export function scaleSize(base, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return base * (0.65 + 0.5 * vel);
}

/* ---------- fade curve ---------- */

export function squareAlpha(t, life, fadeIn = 0.18, fadeOut = 1.3) {
  if (t < 0 || t > life) return 0;
  const aIn = clamp(t / fadeIn, 0, 1);
  const remain = life - t;
  const aOut = remain < fadeOut ? clamp(remain / fadeOut, 0, 1) : 1;
  return aIn * aOut;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    s.mesh.position[s.horizontal ? 'x' : 'y'] += (s.sign * v * dt) * (s.horizontal ? 1 : 1) * 1; // horizontal axis uses x
    if (s.horizontal) { /* handled above */ }
    s.mesh.position[s.horizontal ? 'x' : 'y'] += 0; // no-op guard
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += 0; // no-op
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt * 0; // keep single movement below
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += 0;
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt * 0;
    // drift (single source of motion):
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt * 0; // no-op
    // Actually move directly for clarity:
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

export const CA_RULES = [
  90, 110, 150, 60, 73, 99, 135, 45, 22, 3, 5, 21, 51, 17, 103, 61,
];

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Geometric mapping: CC=64 is exactly 1.00x (geometric mean of range).
export function ccScale(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SIZE_RANGE;
  const t = clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127;
  return Math.sqrt(lo * hi) * Math.pow(hi / lo, t - 0.5);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function pickRandomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return CA_RULES[Math.floor(rng() * CA_RULES.length)];
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSize: 60 + rng() * 160,
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    life: 4 + rng() * 3.5,
    rule: pickRandomRule(rng),
  };
}

export function scaleVelocity(base, speedMultiplier) {
  return base * speedMultiplier;
}

export function scaleSize(base, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return base * (0.65 + 0.5 * vel);
}

/* ---------- fade curve ---------- */

/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

export const CA_RULES = [
  90, 110, 150, 60, 73, 99, 135, 45, 22, 3, 5, 21, 51, 17, 103, 61,
];

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);
  return data;
}

// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.
export function makePatternData(rule, width, height) {
  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    rgba[i * 4 + 0] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 1] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 2] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 3] = cells[i] ? 255 : 0;
  }
  return rgba;
}

/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */

export const CC = {
  WIDTH: 7,
  SPEED: 10,
  BRIGHTNESS: 11,
  SIZE: 14,
};

export const CC_DEFAULTS = {
  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,
  [CC.SPEED]: 64,
  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,
  [CC.SIZE]: 64,
};

export const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];
export const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];
export const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];
export const SIZE_RANGE = [0.25, 4.0];

export function ccWidthCells(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;
  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));
}

export function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Geometric mapping: CC=64 is exactly 1.00x (geometric mean of range).
export function ccScale(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SIZE_RANGE;
  const t = clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127;
  return Math.sqrt(lo * hi) * Math.pow(hi / lo, t - 0.5);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function pickRandomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return CA_RULES[Math.floor(rng() * CA_RULES.length)];
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSize: 60 + rng() * 160,
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    life: 4 + rng() * 3.5,
    rule: pickRandomRule(rng),
  };
}

export function scaleVelocity(base, speedMultiplier) {
  return base * speedMultiplier;
}

export function scaleSize(base, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return base * (0.65 + 0.5 * vel);
}

/* ---------- fade curve ---------- */

export function squareAlpha(t, life, fadeIn = 0.18, fadeOut = 1.3) {
  if (t < 0 || t > life) return 0;
  const aIn = clamp(t / fadeIn, 0, 1);
  const remain = life - t;
  const aOut = remain < fadeOut ? clamp(remain / fadeOut, 0, 1) : 1;
  return aIn * aOut;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

import {
  CC, CC_DEFAULTS, WIDTH_RANGE,
  makePatternData, ccWidthCells, ccSpeedMultiplier, ccBrightness, ccScale,
  pitchToHue, clamp, randomSquare, scaleSize, scaleVelocity, squareAlpha,
} from './ca.js';

const TEXTURE_HEIGHT = 96;
const MAX_SQUARES = 40;
const SYSTEM_FPS = 60;

const canvasEl = document.getElementById('canvas');

/* ---------- scene setup ---------- */
let width = window.innerWidth;
let height = window.innerHeight;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: canvasEl, alpha: true, antialias: true, premultipliedAlpha: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
renderer.setSize(width, height);
renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
renderer.autoClear = true;

const camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-width / 2, width / 2, height / 2, -height / 2, 0.1, 10);
camera.position.set(0, 0, 5);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const planeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1);

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const state = {
  cc: { [CC.WIDTH]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.WIDTH], [CC.SPEED]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.SPEED], [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.BRIGHTNESS], [CC.SIZE]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.SIZE] },
  blendMode: 'additive',
  autoplay: false,
  lastSpawnAt: 0,
  lastTime: performance.now(),
  squares: [],
  dirtyTextures: false,
};

/* ---------- materials ---------- */
function makeSquareMaterial(hue) {
  const color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(hue, 0.85, 0.62);
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: {
      uPattern: { value: null },
      uColor: { value: color },
      uFade: { value: 1 },
      uIntensity: { value: 1 },
      uMode: { value: 0 },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      uniform sampler2D uPattern;
      uniform vec3 uColor;
      uniform float uFade;
      uniform float uIntensity;
      uniform float uMode;
      void main() {
        vec4 p = texture2D(uPattern, vUv);
        float a = p.a * uFade * uIntensity;
        vec3 rgb;
        if (uMode > 1.5) {
          rgb = mix(vec3(1.0), uColor, clamp(a, 0.0, 1.0));
        } else {
          rgb = uColor * a;
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, a);
      }`,
  });
  return mat;
}

function applyBlendingTo(m, mode) {
  m.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
  m.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
  m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  if (mode === 'normal') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'additive') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'multiply') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 2;
  } else if (mode === 'subtract') {
    m.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else {
    throw new Error('unknown blending mode: ' + mode);
  }
}

function applyBlending(mode) {
  for (const s of state.squares) applyBlendingTo(s.material, mode);
}

/* ---------- square lifecycle ---------- */
function makePatternFor(rule, width) {
  const rgba = makePatternData(rule, width, TEXTURE_HEIGHT);
  const tex = new THREE.DataTexture(rgba, width, TEXTURE_HEIGHT, THREE.RGBAFormat);
  tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
  tex.generateMipmaps = false;
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  return tex;
}

function createSquare({ note, velocity }) {
  const cfg = randomSquare();
  const size = scaleSize(cfg.baseSize, velocity);
  const speedBase = cfg.baseVelocity;
  const hues = pitchToHue(note);

  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const tex = makePatternFor(cfg.rule, w);
  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);
  material.uniforms.uPattern.value = tex;
  material.uniforms.uFade.value = 0;
  material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  applyBlendingTo(material, state.blendMode);

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, material);
  mesh.scale.set(size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), 1);
  mesh.position.set(
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * width,
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * height,
    0
  );
  mesh.rotation.z = cfg.horizontal ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  mesh.visible = true;

  scene.add(mesh);
  const square = {
    mesh, material, texture: tex,
    axis: cfg.axis, sign: cfg.sign, horizontal: cfg.horizontal,
    size, baseVelocity: speedBase, life: cfg.life, rule: cfg.rule,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

function destroySquare(s) {
  scene.remove(s.mesh);
  s.texture.dispose();
  s.material.dispose();
}

function refreshTexturesForWidth(newWidth) {
  for (const s of state.squares) {
    if (s.widthCells === newWidth) continue;
    const oldTex = s.texture;
    s.texture = makePatternFor(s.rule, newWidth);
    s.material.uniforms.uPattern.value = s.texture;
    s.widthCells = newWidth;
    oldTex.dispose();
  }
}

function clearSquares() {
  for (const s of state.squares) destroySquare(s);
  state.squares = [];
}

/* ---------- animation ---------- */
function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

/* ---------- MIDI ---------- */
let midiAccess = null;
const subscribedInputs = new Set();

function pickRandomNote() {
  return 48 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 48); // C3..C7
}

async function connectMidi() {
  try {
    midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false });
    midiAccess.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribeToMidiInputs();
    setMidiStatus('connected', midiAccess.inputs.size);
  } catch (err) {
    setMidiStatus('unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'not allowed'));
  }
}

function subscribeToMidiInputs() {
  if (!midiAccess) return;
  for (const input of midiAccess.inputs.values()) {
    if (subscribedInputs.has(input)) continue;
    input.onmidimessage = onMidiMessage;
    input.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribedInputs.add(input);
  }
}

function handleMidiStateChange() {
  subscribeToMidiInputs();
  setMidiStatus(midiAccess && midiAccess.inputs.size > 0 ? 'connected' : 'no MIDI inputs', midiAccess ? midiAccess.inputs.size : 0);
}

function onMidiMessage(e) {
  const [status, d1, d2] = e.data;
  const cmd = status & 0xf0;
  const channel = status & 0x0f;

  if (channel === 1) { // channel 2: intentionally idle for now
    setReadout('channel 2 event (idle)');
    return;
  }
  if (channel !== 0) return;

  if (cmd === 0x90 && d2 > 0) { // note on
    spawnNote(d1, d2);
  } else if (cmd === 0xB0) { // control change
    const val = clamp(d2, 0, 127);
    if (val === undefined) return;
    if (d1 in CC_DEFAULTS) {
      state.cc[d1] = val;
      if (d1 === CC.WIDTH) state.dirtyTextures = true;
      syncControlsFromState();
      setReadout('CC ' + d1 + ' = ' + val);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- spawning ---------- */
function spawnNote(note, velocity) {
  const square = createSquare({ note, velocity });
  setReadout('note ' + note + ' (v' + velocity + ')');
  return square;
}

/* ---------- UI ---------- */
const ui = {
  panel: document.getElementById('panel'),
  toggle: document.getElementById('toggle'),
  btnMidi: document.getElementById('btn-midi'),
  btnNote: document.getElementById('btn-note'),
  btnClear: document.getElementById('btn-clear'),
  autoplay: document.getElementById('autoplay'),
  blend: document.getElementById('blend'),
  blendValue: document.getElementById('blend-value'),
  sliderWidth: document.getElementById('slider-width'),
  sliderSize: document.getElementById('slider-size'),
  sliderSpeed: document.getElementById('slider-speed'),
  sliderBright: document.getElementById('slider-bright'),
  widthValue: document.getElementById('value-width'),
  sizeValue: document.getElementById('value-size'),
  speedValue: document.getElementById('value-speed'),
  brightValue: document.getElementById('value-bright'),
  midiStatus: document.getElementById('midi-status'),
  readout: document.getElementById('readout'),
  live: document.getElementById('live'),
};

function setMidiStatus(text, count) {
  let msg = text;
  if (typeof count === 'number' && text === 'connected') {
    msg = 'connected (' + count + ' input' + (count === 1 ? '' : 's') + ')';
  }
  ui.midiStatus.textContent = 'MIDI: ' + msg;
}

function updateLiveReadout() {
  ui.live.textContent =
    'CC 7 (width): ' + state.cc[CC.WIDTH] + ' → ' + ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]) + ' cells' +
    ' · CC 14 (size): ' + state.cc[CC.SIZE] + ' → ' + ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]).toFixed(2) + 'x' +
    ' · CC 10 (speed): ' + state.cc[CC.SPEED] + ' → ' + ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]).toFixed(2) + 'x' +
    ' · CC 11 (bright): ' + state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS] + ' → ' + ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]).toFixed(2) + 'x';
}

function setReadout(text) {
  ui.readout.textContent = text || '–';
  window.clearTimeout(setReadout.timeout);
  setReadout.timeout = window.setTimeout(() => { ui.readout.textContent = '–'; }, 1200);
}

function syncControlsFromState() {
  ui.blend.value = state.blendMode;
  ui.blendValue.textContent = state.blendMode;
  ui.sliderWidth.value = state.cc[CC.WIDTH];
  ui.sliderSpeed.value = state.cc[CC.SPEED];
  ui.sliderBright.value = state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS];
  ui.sliderSize.value = state.cc[CC.SIZE];
  ui.widthValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.WIDTH] + ' (' + ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]) + ' cells)';
  ui.sizeValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.SIZE] + ' (' + ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]).toFixed(2) + 'x)';
  ui.speedValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.SPEED] + ' (' + ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]).toFixed(2) + 'x)';
  ui.brightValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS] + ' (' + ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]).toFixed(2) + 'x)';
  updateLiveReadout();
}

function wireSlider(slider, valueBox, ccEdit, formatter) {
  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const v = clamp(parseInt(slider.value, 10) || 0, 0, 127);
    state.cc[ccEdit] = v;
    if (ccEdit === CC.WIDTH) state.dirtyTextures = true;
    valueBox.textContent = v + ' (' + formatter(v) + ')';
    updateLiveReadout();
  });
}

wireSlider(ui.sliderWidth, ui.widthValue, CC.WIDTH, v => ccWidthCells(v) + ' cells');
wireSlider(ui.sliderSize, ui.sizeValue, CC.SIZE, v => ccScale(v).toFixed(2) + 'x');
wireSlider(ui.sliderSpeed, ui.speedValue, CC.SPEED, v => ccSpeedMultiplier(v).toFixed(2) + 'x');
wireSlider(ui.sliderBright, ui.brightValue, CC.BRIGHTNESS, v => ccBrightness(v).toFixed(2) + 'x');

ui.btnNote.addEventListener('click', () => spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 90 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 38)));
ui.btnClear.addEventListener('click', () => { clearSquares(); setReadout('cleared'); });
ui.btnMidi.addEventListener('click', () => { connectMidi(); setReadout('connecting…'); });
ui.autoplay.addEventListener('change', () => { state.autoplay = ui.autoplay.checked; });
ui.blend.addEventListener('change', () => {
  state.blendMode = ui.blend.value;
  ui.blendValue.textContent = state.blendMode;
  applyBlending(state.blendMode);
  setReadout('blend: ' + state.blendMode);
});

ui.toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const hidden = ui.panel.classList.toggle('hidden');
  ui.toggle.textContent = hidden ? '◀ Show controls' : 'Hide controls';
});

window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
function onResize() {
  width = window.innerWidth;
  height = window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(width, height);
  camera.left = -width / 2; camera.right = width / 2;
  camera.top = height / 2; camera.bottom = -height / 2;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
  syncControlsFromState();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  connectMidi();
});

/* ---------- animation ---------- */
function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

/* ---------- MIDI ---------- */

function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
=================
function createSquare({ note, velocity }) {
  const cfg = randomSquare();
  const size = scaleSize(cfg.baseSize, velocity);
  const speedBase = cfg.baseVelocity;
  const hues = pitchToHue(note);

  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const tex = makePatternFor(cfg.rule, w);
  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);
  material.uniforms.uPattern.value = tex;
  material.uniforms.uFade.value = 0;
  material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  applyBlendingTo(material, state.blendMode);

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, material);
  mesh.scale.set(size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), 1);
  mesh.position.set(
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * width,
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * height,
    0
  );
  mesh.rotation.z = cfg.horizontal ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  mesh.visible = true;

  scene.add(mesh);
  const square = {
    mesh, material, texture: tex,
    axis: cfg.axis, sign: cfg.sign, horizontal: cfg.horizontal,
    size, baseVelocity: speedBase, life: cfg.life, rule: cfg.rule,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

export const CA_RULES = [
  90, 110, 150, 60, 73, 99, 135, 45, 22, 3, 5, 21, 51, 17, 103, 61,
];

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);
  return data;
}

// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.
export function makePatternData(rule, width, height) {
  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    rgba[i * 4 + 0] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 1] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 2] = 255;
    rgba[i * 4 + 3] = cells[i] ? 255 : 0;
  }
  return rgba;
}

/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */

export const CC = {
  WIDTH: 7,
  SPEED: 10,
  BRIGHTNESS: 11,
  SIZE: 14,
};

export const CC_DEFAULTS = {
  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,
  [CC.SPEED]: 64,
  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,
  [CC.SIZE]: 64,
};

export const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];
export const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];
export const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];
export const SIZE_RANGE = [0.25, 4.0];

export function ccWidthCells(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;
  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));
}

export function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Geometric mapping: CC=64 is exactly 1.00x (geometric mean of range).
export function ccScale(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SIZE_RANGE;
  const t = clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127;
  return Math.sqrt(lo * hi) * Math.pow(hi / lo, t - 0.5);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function pickRandomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return CA_RULES[Math.floor(rng() * CA_RULES.length)];
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSize: 60 + rng() * 160,
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    life: 4 + rng() * 3.5,
    rule: pickRandomRule(rng),
  };
}

export function scaleVelocity(base, speedMultiplier) {
  return base * speedMultiplier;
}

export function scaleSize(base, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return base * (0.65 + 0.5 * vel);
}

/* ---------- fade curve ---------- */

export function squareAlpha(t, life, fadeIn = 0.18, fadeOut = 1.3) {
  if (t < 0 || t > life) return 0;
  const aIn = clamp(t / fadeIn, 0, 1);
  const remain = life - t;
  const aOut = remain < fadeOut ? clamp(remain / fadeOut, 0, 1) : 1;
  return aIn * aOut;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

## tool result (terminal)

import {
  CC, CC_DEFAULTS, WIDTH_RANGE,
  makePatternData, ccWidthCells, ccSpeedMultiplier, ccBrightness, ccScale,
  pitchToHue, clamp, randomSquare, scaleSize, scaleVelocity, squareAlpha,
} from './ca.js';

const TEXTURE_HEIGHT = 96;
const MAX_SQUARES = 40;
const SYSTEM_FPS = 60;

const canvasEl = document.getElementById('canvas');

/* ---------- scene setup ---------- */
let width = window.innerWidth;
let height = window.innerHeight;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: canvasEl, alpha: true, antialias: true, premultipliedAlpha: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
renderer.setSize(width, height);
renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
renderer.autoClear = true;

const camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-width / 2, width / 2, height / 2, -height / 2, 0.1, 10);
camera.position.set(0, 0, 5);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const planeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1);

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const state = {
  cc: { [CC.WIDTH]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.WIDTH], [CC.SPEED]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.SPEED], [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.BRIGHTNESS], [CC.SIZE]: CC_DEFAULTS[CC.SIZE] },
  blendMode: 'additive',
  autoplay: false,
  lastSpawnAt: 0,
  lastTime: performance.now(),
  squares: [],
  dirtyTextures: false,
};

/* ---------- materials ---------- */
function makeSquareMaterial(hue) {
  const color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(hue, 0.85, 0.62);
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: {
      uPattern: { value: null },
      uColor: { value: color },
      uFade: { value: 1 },
      uIntensity: { value: 1 },
      uMode: { value: 0 },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      uniform sampler2D uPattern;
      uniform vec3 uColor;
      uniform float uFade;
      uniform float uIntensity;
      uniform float uMode;
      void main() {
        vec4 p = texture2D(uPattern, vUv);
        float a = p.a * uFade * uIntensity;
        vec3 rgb;
        if (uMode > 1.5) {
          rgb = mix(vec3(1.0), uColor, clamp(a, 0.0, 1.0));
        } else {
          rgb = uColor * a;
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, a);
      }`,
  });
  return mat;
}

function applyBlendingTo(m, mode) {
  m.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
  m.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
  m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  if (mode === 'normal') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'additive') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'multiply') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 2;
  } else if (mode === 'subtract') {
    m.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else {
    throw new Error('unknown blending mode: ' + mode);
  }
}

function applyBlending(mode) {
  for (const s of state.squares) applyBlendingTo(s.material, mode);
}

/* ---------- square lifecycle ---------- */
function makePatternFor(rule, width) {
  const rgba = makePatternData(rule, width, TEXTURE_HEIGHT);
  const tex = new THREE.DataTexture(rgba, width, TEXTURE_HEIGHT, THREE.RGBAFormat);
  tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
  tex.generateMipmaps = false;
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  return tex;
}

function createSquare({ note, velocity }) {
  const cfg = randomSquare();
  const size = scaleSize(cfg.baseSize, velocity);
  const speedBase = cfg.baseVelocity;
  const hues = pitchToHue(note);

  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const tex = makePatternFor(cfg.rule, w);
  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);
  material.uniforms.uPattern.value = tex;
  material.uniforms.uFade.value = 0;
  material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  applyBlendingTo(material, state.blendMode);

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, material);
  mesh.scale.set(size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), 1);
  mesh.position.set(
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * width,
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * height,
    0
  );
  mesh.rotation.z = cfg.horizontal ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  mesh.visible = true;

  scene.add(mesh);
  const square = {
    mesh, material, texture: tex,
    axis: cfg.axis, sign: cfg.sign, horizontal: cfg.horizontal,
    size, baseVelocity: speedBase, life: cfg.life, rule: cfg.rule,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

function destroySquare(s) {
  scene.remove(s.mesh);
  s.texture.dispose();
  s.material.dispose();
}

function refreshTexturesForWidth(newWidth) {
  for (const s of state.squares) {
    if (s.widthCells === newWidth) continue;
    const oldTex = s.texture;
    s.texture = makePatternFor(s.rule, newWidth);
    s.material.uniforms.uPattern.value = s.texture;
    s.widthCells = newWidth;
    oldTex.dispose();
  }
}

function clearSquares() {
  for (const s of state.squares) destroySquare(s);
  state.squares = [];
}

/* ---------- animation ---------- */
function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

/* ---------- MIDI ---------- */
let midiAccess = null;
const subscribedInputs = new Set();

function pickRandomNote() {
  return 48 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 48); // C3..C7
}

async function connectMidi() {
  try {
    midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false });
    midiAccess.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribeToMidiInputs();
    setMidiStatus('connected', midiAccess.inputs.size);
  } catch (err) {
    setMidiStatus('unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'not allowed'));
  }
}

function subscribeToMidiInputs() {
  if (!midiAccess) return;
  for (const input of midiAccess.inputs.values()) {
    if (subscribedInputs.has(input)) continue;
    input.onmidimessage = onMidiMessage;
    input.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribedInputs.add(input);
  }
}

function handleMidiStateChange() {
  subscribeToMidiInputs();
  setMidiStatus(midiAccess && midiAccess.inputs.size > 0 ? 'connected' : 'no MIDI inputs', midiAccess ? midiAccess.inputs.size : 0);
}

function onMidiMessage(e) {
  const [status, d1, d2] = e.data;
  const cmd = status & 0xf0;
  const channel = status & 0x0f;

  if (channel === 1) { // channel 2: intentionally idle for now
    setReadout('channel 2 event (idle)');
    return;
  }
  if (channel !== 0) return;

  if (cmd === 0x90 && d2 > 0) { // note on
    spawnNote(d1, d2);
  } else if (cmd === 0xB0) { // control change
    const val = clamp(d2, 0, 127);
    if (val === undefined) return;
    if (d1 in CC_DEFAULTS) {
      state.cc[d1] = val;
      if (d1 === CC.WIDTH) state.dirtyTextures = true;
      syncControlsFromState();
      setReadout('CC ' + d1 + ' = ' + val);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- spawning ---------- */
function spawnNote(note, velocity) {
  const square = createSquare({ note, velocity });
  setReadout('note ' + note + ' (v' + velocity + ')');
  return square;
}

/* ---------- UI ---------- */
const ui = {
  panel: document.getElementById('panel'),
  toggle: document.getElementById('toggle'),
  btnMidi: document.getElementById('btn-midi'),
  btnNote: document.getElementById('btn-note'),
  btnClear: document.getElementById('btn-clear'),
  autoplay: document.getElementById('autoplay'),
  blend: document.getElementById('blend'),
  blendValue: document.getElementById('blend-value'),
  sliderWidth: document.getElementById('slider-width'),
  sliderSize: document.getElementById('slider-size'),
  sliderSpeed: document.getElementById('slider-speed'),
  sliderBright: document.getElementById('slider-bright'),
  widthValue: document.getElementById('value-width'),
  sizeValue: document.getElementById('value-size'),
  speedValue: document.getElementById('value-speed'),
  brightValue: document.getElementById('value-bright'),
  midiStatus: document.getElementById('midi-status'),
  readout: document.getElementById('readout'),
  live: document.getElementById('live'),
};

function setMidiStatus(text, count) {
  let msg = text;
  if (typeof count === 'number' && text === 'connected') {
    msg = 'connected (' + count + ' input' + (count === 1 ? '' : 's') + ')';
  }
  ui.midiStatus.textContent = 'MIDI: ' + msg;
}

function updateLiveReadout() {
  ui.live.textContent =
    'CC 7 (width): ' + state.cc[CC.WIDTH] + ' → ' + ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]) + ' cells' +
    ' · CC 14 (size): ' + state.cc[CC.SIZE] + ' → ' + ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]).toFixed(2) + 'x' +
    ' · CC 10 (speed): ' + state.cc[CC.SPEED] + ' → ' + ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]).toFixed(2) + 'x' +
    ' · CC 11 (bright): ' + state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS] + ' → ' + ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]).toFixed(2) + 'x';
}

function setReadout(text) {
  ui.readout.textContent = text || '–';
  window.clearTimeout(setReadout.timeout);
  setReadout.timeout = window.setTimeout(() => { ui.readout.textContent = '–'; }, 1200);
}

function syncControlsFromState() {
  ui.blend.value = state.blendMode;
  ui.blendValue.textContent = state.blendMode;
  ui.sliderWidth.value = state.cc[CC.WIDTH];
  ui.sliderSpeed.value = state.cc[CC.SPEED];
  ui.sliderBright.value = state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS];
  ui.sliderSize.value = state.cc[CC.SIZE];
  ui.widthValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.WIDTH] + ' (' + ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]) + ' cells)';
  ui.sizeValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.SIZE] + ' (' + ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]).toFixed(2) + 'x)';
  ui.speedValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.SPEED] + ' (' + ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]).toFixed(2) + 'x)';
  ui.brightValue.textContent = state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS] + ' (' + ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]).toFixed(2) + 'x)';
  updateLiveReadout();
}

function wireSlider(slider, valueBox, ccEdit, formatter) {
  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const v = clamp(parseInt(slider.value, 10) || 0, 0, 127);
    state.cc[ccEdit] = v;
    if (ccEdit === CC.WIDTH) state.dirtyTextures = true;
    valueBox.textContent = v + ' (' + formatter(v) + ')';
    updateLiveReadout();
  });
}

wireSlider(ui.sliderWidth, ui.widthValue, CC.WIDTH, v => ccWidthCells(v) + ' cells');
wireSlider(ui.sliderSize, ui.sizeValue, CC.SIZE, v => ccScale(v).toFixed(2) + 'x');
wireSlider(ui.sliderSpeed, ui.speedValue, CC.SPEED, v => ccSpeedMultiplier(v).toFixed(2) + 'x');
wireSlider(ui.sliderBright, ui.brightValue, CC.BRIGHTNESS, v => ccBrightness(v).toFixed(2) + 'x');

ui.btnNote.addEventListener('click', () => spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 90 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 38)));
ui.btnClear.addEventListener('click', () => { clearSquares(); setReadout('cleared'); });
ui.btnMidi.addEventListener('click', () => { connectMidi(); setReadout('connecting…'); });
ui.autoplay.addEventListener('change', () => { state.autoplay = ui.autoplay.checked; });
ui.blend.addEventListener('change', () => {
  state.blendMode = ui.blend.value;
  ui.blendValue.textContent = state.blendMode;
  applyBlending(state.blendMode);
  setReadout('blend: ' + state.blendMode);
});

ui.toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const hidden = ui.panel.classList.toggle('hidden');
  ui.toggle.textContent = hidden ? '◀ Show controls' : 'Hide controls';
});

window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
function onResize() {
  width = window.innerWidth;
  height = window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(width, height);
  camera.left = -width / 2; camera.right = width / 2;
  camera.top = height / 2; camera.bottom = -height / 2;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
  syncControlsFromState();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  connectMidi();
});

   ```js
   export const RULE_REG_RANDOM = 2, RULE_REG_EVEN = 3, RULE_REG_ODD = 4;
   export function selectRule(lowV, registerV, rng) {
     const low = clamp(lowV,0,127);
     switch (registerV) {
       case 0: return low;
       case 1: return 128 + low;
       case 2: return Math.floor((rng||Math.random)() * 256);
       case 3: return low * 2;
       case 4: return low * 2 + 1;
       default: return 0;
     }
   }
   ```

}

```js
export function selectRule(low, register, rng = Math.random) {
  const reg = Math.round(clamp(register, 0, 4));
  const l = clamp(low, 0, 127);
  if (reg === 0) return l;
  if (reg === 1) return Math.min(255, 128 + l);
  if (reg === 2) return Math.floor(rng() * 256);
  if (reg === 3) return l * 2;          // 0..254 even
  if (reg === 4) return l * 2 + 1;      // 1..255 odd
  return l;
}
```

- iy=0: y=-height_half → vertex position y=+height_half (TOP of plane), uv.y=1.

So uv.y=1 at top of screen, uv.y=0 at bottom. Texture data row 0 = uv.y=0 (flipY=false) = bottom of plane. Data row height-1 = uv.y=1 = top. Generation 0 (seed) at data row 0 = bottom of screen, generations flow upward. ✓ as I assumed.

"Offset downwards": cells move toward uv.y=0 (bottom) → data row decreases → new[g] = old[g + N]. ✓ (top N rows blank).

Horizontal: uv.x=0 at left. Data col 0 = uv.x=0 = left. Cell at data col x moves to col x - M (mod width) → new col x = old col (x + M) mod width. ✓ Pattern slides left.

function createSquare({ note, velocity }) {
  const cfg = randomSquare();
  const size = scaleSize(cfg.baseSize, velocity);
  const speedBase = cfg.baseVelocity;
  const hues = pitchToHue(note);

  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const tex = makePatternFor(cfg.rule, w);
  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);
  material.uniforms.uPattern.value = tex;
  material.uniforms.uFade.value = 0;
  material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  applyBlendingTo(material, state.blendMode);

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, material);
  mesh.scale.set(size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), size * ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]), 1);
  mesh.position.set(
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * width,
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * height,
    0
  );
  mesh.rotation.z = cfg.horizontal ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  mesh.visible = true;

  scene.add(mesh);
  const square = {
    mesh, material, texture: tex,
    axis: cfg.axis, sign: cfg.sign, horizontal: cfg.horizontal,
    size, baseVelocity: speedBase, life: cfg.life, rule: cfg.rule,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

function destroySquare(s) {
  scene.remove(s.mesh);
  s.texture.dispose();
  s.material.dispose();
}

function refreshTexturesForWidth(newWidth) {
  for (const s of state.squares) {
    if (s.widthCells === newWidth) continue;
    const oldTex = s.texture;
    s.texture = makePatternFor(s.rule, newWidth);
    s.material.uniforms.uPattern.value = s.texture;
    s.widthCells = newWidth;
    oldTex.dispose();
  }
}

function clearSquares() {
  for (const s of state.squares) destroySquare(s);
  state.squares = [];
}

/* ---------- animation ---------- */
function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
    refreshTexturesForWidth(w);
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const scale = ccScale(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;
    const alpha = squareAlpha(t, s.life);
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    const sz = s.size * scale;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);
    if (s.horizontal) s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
    else s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
    if (t >= s.life || alpha <= 0) {
      destroySquare(s);
      state.squares.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
