/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
// Generation 0 = seed row (this ends up at the BOTTOM of the on-screen square:
// see visualiser.js where the DataTexture row 0 maps to uv.y = 0).
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);
  return data;
}

// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.
// offsetX: cells of pattern shift to the LEFT (wrapping around the width).
// offsetY: cells of pattern shift DOWNWARD (blank rows appear at the top).
export function makePatternData(rule, width, height, opts = {}) {
  const offsetX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.offsetX || 0));
  const offsetY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.offsetY || 0));
  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const srcX = (x + offsetX) % width;        // pattern moved LEFT by offsetX cells
      const srcRow = g + offsetY;                  // pattern moved DOWN by offsetY rows
      const idx = g * width + x;
      const v = srcRow < height ? cells[srcRow * width + srcX] : 0;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 0] = 255;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 1] = 255;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 2] = 255;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 3] = v ? 255 : 0;
    }
  }
  return rgba;
}

/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */

export const CC = {
  WIDTH: 7,
  SPEED: 10,
  BRIGHTNESS: 11,
  SIZE: 14,
  OFFSET_LEFT: 15,
  OFFSET_DOWN: 16,
  RULE_LOW: 17,
  RULE_REG: 18,
};

export const CC_DEFAULTS = {
  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,
  [CC.SPEED]: 64,
  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,
  [CC.SIZE]: 64,
  [CC.OFFSET_LEFT]: 0,
  [CC.OFFSET_DOWN]: 0,
  [CC.RULE_LOW]: 64,
  [CC.RULE_REG]: 0,
};

export const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];
export const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];
export const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];
// Square size is expressed as a percentage of the screen's smaller dimension,
// so a 100% square is as big as the total screen, whatever the aspect ratio.
export const SIZE_RANGE = [4, 100];

export function ccWidthCells(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;
  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));
}

export function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Linear mapping: CC 64 (mid) lands near the middle of the range.
export function ccSizePercent(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SIZE_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Offsets in cells: raw CC 0..127 maps linearly onto 0..maxCells.
export function ccOffsetCells(v, maxCells) {
  const t = clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127;
  return Math.round(t * Math.max(0, maxCells));
}

/* ---------- formula (rule) selection ---------- */

// Registers for CC 18 (formula selector).
export const RULE_REG = {
  RANGE_LOW: 0,   // CC 17 value is itself the rule (0-127)
  RANGE_HIGH: 1,  // 128 + CC 17 value (128-255)
  RANDOM: 2,      // each spawn picks a uniformly random rule 0..255
  EVEN: 3,        // even rules only: CC 17 value * 2 (0, 2, ... 254)
  ODD: 4,         // odd rules only: CC 17 value * 2 + 1 (1, 3, ... 255)
};

export const RULE_REG_LABELS = [
  '0-127',
  '128-255',
  'random',
  'even-only (0,2,…,254)',
  'odd-only (1,3,…,255)',
];

export function ruleRegister(v) {
  return clamp(Math.round(clamp(v, 0, 127)), 0, 4);
}

export function randomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return Math.floor(rng() * 256);
}

// Resolve the current formula. `low` is the raw CC 17 value (0..127);
// `register` is CC 18 value (clamped to the 0..4 register). In RANDOM mode a
// fresh rule is rolled; other modes are deterministic.
export function selectRule(low, register, rng = Math.random) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(register);
  const l = clamp(low, 0, 127);
  switch (reg) {
    case RULE_REG.RANGE_LOW: return l;
    case RULE_REG.RANGE_HIGH: return Math.min(255, 128 + l);
    case RULE_REG.RANDOM: return randomRule(rng);
    case RULE_REG.EVEN: return l * 2;
    case RULE_REG.ODD: return l * 2 + 1;
    default: return l;
  }
}

export function ruleLabel(low, register) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(register);
  if (reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM) return 'random';
  return 'rule ' + selectRule(low, reg);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random, rule) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSizeFactor: 0.8 + rng() * 0.4, // per-square size multiplier (0.80-1.20)
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    rule: rule === undefined ? randomRule(rng) : rule,
  };
}

export function scaleSize(baseFactor, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return baseFactor * (0.7 + 0.5 * vel);
}


/* fade in / decay lifecycle */

// Held squares fade in over FADE_IN seconds, then stay at full intensity.
export function heldFadeIn(secondsSinceSpawn, fadeIn = 0.18) {
  return clamp(secondsSinceSpawn / fadeIn, 0, 1);
}

// Decaying squares (note-off arrived) fade out over fadeOut seconds.
export function decayAlpha(secondsSinceNoteOff, fadeOut = 1.3) {
  if (secondsSinceNoteOff < 0 || secondsSinceNoteOff >= fadeOut) return 0;
  return 1 - secondsSinceNoteOff / fadeOut;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

// Human-readable name for a formula register (0..4).
export function registerName(register) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(register);
  return RULE_REG_LABELS[reg] ?? 'unknown';
}

function createSquare({ note, velocity }) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG]);
  const rule = reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM
    ? randomRule()
    : selectRule(state.cc[CC.RULE_LOW], reg);
  const cfg = randomSquare(Math.random, rule);
  const sizeFactor = scaleSize(cfg.baseSizeFactor, velocity);
  const speedBase = cfg.baseVelocity;
  const hues = pitchToHue(note);

  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const offX = ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_LEFT], w);
  const offY = ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_DOWN], TEXTURE_HEIGHT);
  const tex = makePatternFor(cfg.rule, w, { offsetX: offX, offsetY: offY });
  const material = makeSquareMaterial(hues);
  material.uniforms.uPattern.value = tex;
  material.uniforms.uFade.value = 0;
  material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  applyBlendingTo(material, state.blendMode);

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, material);
  const initialSide = Math.min(100, ccSizePercent(state.cc[CC.SIZE]) * sizeFactor) / 100 * Math.min(width, height);
  mesh.scale.set(initialSide, initialSide, 1);
  mesh.position.set(
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * width,
    (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4) * height,
    0
  );
  mesh.rotation.z = cfg.horizontal ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  mesh.visible = true;

  scene.add(mesh);
  const square = {
    mesh, material, texture: tex,
    axis: cfg.axis, sign: cfg.sign, horizontal: cfg.horizontal,
    sizeFactor, baseVelocity: speedBase, rule: cfg.rule,
    note, held: true, decayingAt: null,
    offsetX: offX, offsetY: offY,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

function destroySquare(s) {
  scene.remove(s.mesh);
  s.texture.dispose();
  s.material.dispose();
}

function refreshTextures() {
  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const offX = ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_LEFT], w);
  const offY = ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_DOWN], TEXTURE_HEIGHT);
  const reg = ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG]);
  const rule = reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM ? null : selectRule(state.cc[CC.RULE_LOW], reg);
  for (const s of state.squares) {
    if (rule !== null) s.rule = rule; // in random mode each square keeps its own rule
    const oldTex = s.texture;
    s.texture = makePatternFor(s.rule, w, { offsetX: offX, offsetY: offY });
    s.material.uniforms.uPattern.value = s.texture;
    s.widthCells = w;
    s.offsetX = offX;
    s.offsetY = offY;
    oldTex.dispose();
  }
}

  for (const s of state.squares) destroySquare(s);

}

function makeSquareMaterial(hue) {
  const color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(hue, 0.85, 0.62);
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: {
      uPattern: { value: null },
      uColor: { value: color },
      uFade: { value: 1 },
      uIntensity: { value: 1 },
      uMode: { value: 0 },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      uniform sampler2D uPattern;
      uniform vec3 uColor;
      uniform float uFade;
      uniform float uIntensity;
      uniform float uMode;
      void main() {
        vec4 p = texture2D(uPattern, vUv);
        float a = p.a * uFade * uIntensity;
        vec3 rgb;
        if (uMode > 1.5) {
          rgb = mix(vec3(1.0), uColor, clamp(a, 0.0, 1.0));
        } else {
          rgb = uColor * a;
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, a);
      }`,
  });
  return mat;
}

function applyBlendingTo(m, mode) {
  m.blending = THREE.CustomBlending;
  m.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
  m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
  if (mode === 'normal') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'additive') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else if (mode === 'multiply') {
    m.blendSrc = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.SrcColorFactor;
    m.blendSrcAlpha = THREE.ZeroFactor;
    m.blendDstAlpha = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 2;
  } else if (mode === 'subtract') {
    m.blendEquation = THREE.SubtractEquation;
    m.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
    m.uniforms.uMode.value = 0;
  } else {
    throw new Error('unknown blending mode: ' + mode);
  }
}

function applyBlending(mode) {
  for (const s of state.squares) applyBlendingTo(s.material, mode);
}

/* ---------- MIDI ---------- */
let midiAccess = null;
const subscribedInputs = new Set();

function pickRandomNote() {
  return 48 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 48); // C3..C7
}

async function connectMidi() {
  try {
    midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false });
    midiAccess.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribeToMidiInputs();
    setMidiStatus('connected', midiAccess.inputs.size);
  } catch (err) {
    setMidiStatus('unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'not allowed'));
  }
}

function subscribeToMidiInputs() {
  if (!midiAccess) return;
  for (const input of midiAccess.inputs.values()) {
    if (subscribedInputs.has(input)) continue;
    input.onmidimessage = onMidiMessage;
    input.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribedInputs.add(input);
  }
}

function handleMidiStateChange() {
  subscribeToMidiInputs();
  setMidiStatus(midiAccess && midiAccess.inputs.size > 0 ? 'connected' : 'no MIDI inputs', midiAccess ? midiAccess.inputs.size : 0);
}

function onMidiMessage(e) {
  const [status, d1, d2] = e.data;
  const cmd = status & 0xf0;
  const channel = status & 0x0f;

  if (channel === 1) { // channel 2: intentionally idle for now
    setReadout('channel 2 event (idle)');
    return;
  }
  if (channel !== 0) return;

  if (cmd === 0x90 && d2 > 0) { // note on
    spawnNote(d1, d2);
  } else if (cmd === 0x80 || (cmd === 0x90 && d2 === 0)) { // note off (or velocity-0 note-on)
    decayNote(d1);
  } else if (cmd === 0xB0) { // control change
    const val = clamp(d2, 0, 127);
    if (val === undefined) return;
    if (d1 in CC_DEFAULTS) {
      const v = d1 === CC.RULE_REG ? clamp(val, 0, 4) : val;
      state.cc[d1] = v;
      if (d1 === CC.WIDTH || d1 === CC.OFFSET_LEFT || d1 === CC.OFFSET_DOWN) state.dirtyTextures = true;
      else if (d1 === CC.RULE_LOW || d1 === CC.RULE_REG) {
        if (ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG]) !== RULE_REG.RANDOM) state.dirtyTextures = true;
      }
      syncControlsFromState();
      setReadout('CC ' + d1 + ' = ' + v);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- spawning ---------- */
function spawnNote(note, velocity) {
  const square = createSquare({ note, velocity });
  setReadout('note ' + note + ' (v' + velocity + ')');
  return square;
}

  sq.held = false;
  sq.decayingAt = performance.now();
  if (!quiet && sq.note !== undefined) setReadout('note ' + sq.note + ' off');
}

    if (sq.note === note && sq.held) {

    ' · CC 15 (left): ' + state.cc[CC.OFFSET_LEFT] + ' → ' + ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_LEFT], ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH])) + ' cells' +
    ' · CC 16 (down): ' + state.cc[CC.OFFSET_DOWN] + ' → ' + ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_DOWN], TEXTURE_HEIGHT) + ' cells' +
    ' · CC 17 (rule): ' + state.cc[CC.RULE_LOW] + ' → ' + formulaMapped(state.cc[CC.RULE_LOW], ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG])) +
    ' · CC 18 (reg): ' + state.cc[CC.RULE_REG] + ' (' + registerName(ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG])) + ')';
}

function setReadout(text) {
  ui.readout.textContent = text || '–';
  window.clearTimeout(setReadout.timeout);
  setReadout.timeout = window.setTimeout(() => { ui.readout.textContent = '–'; }, 1200);
}

  updateLiveReadout();
}

function formulaMapped(low, reg) {
  return reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM ? 'random' : 'rule ' + selectRule(low, reg);
}

function wireSlider(slider, valueBox, ccEdit, formatter, opts = {}) {
  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const max = opts.max ?? 127;
    const v = clamp(parseInt(slider.value, 10) || 0, 0, max);
    state.cc[ccEdit] = v;
    if (opts.markDirty && opts.markDirty()) state.dirtyTextures = true;
    valueBox.textContent = v + ' (' + formatter(v) + ')';
    updateLiveReadout();
  });
}

    note, held: true, decayingAt: null,
    offsetX: offX, offsetY: offY,
    hue: hues, widthCells: w,
    spawnedAt: performance.now(),
  };
  state.squares.push(square);
  if (state.squares.length > MAX_SQUARES) {
    const oldest = state.squares.shift();
    destroySquare(oldest);
  }
  return square;
}

function makeSquareMaterial(hue) {

    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: {

      }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      uniform sampler2D uPattern;
      uniform vec3 uColor;
      uniform float uFade;
      uniform float uIntensity;
      uniform float uMode;
      void main() {

/* Pure logic for the MIDI visualiser - no browser/DOM dependencies.
   This file is imported both by the page and by node for tests. */

/* ---------- cellular automata ---------- */

// Standard Wolfram rule table: table[left*4 + center*2 + right] = next cell.
export function makeRuleTable(rule) {
  const out = new Uint8Array(8);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (rule >> i) & 1;
  return out;
}

export function centerRow(width, seedCell = Math.floor(width / 2)) {
  const row = new Uint8Array(width);
  row[seedCell] = 1;
  return row;
}

// Simulate G generations of a 1D CA (cell wrapping). Returns a flat row-major
// Uint8Array of length width*height, index = g*width + x, value 0|1.
// Generation 0 = seed row (this ends up at the BOTTOM of the on-screen square:
// see visualiser.js where the DataTexture row 0 maps to uv.y = 0).
export function simulateCA(rule, width, height, seedRow) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 2) throw new Error('width must be an integer >= 2');
  if (!Number.isInteger(height) || height < 1) throw new Error('height must be an integer >= 1');
  const table = makeRuleTable(rule);
  const rows = [seedRow ? Uint8Array.from(seedRow) : centerRow(width)];
  for (let g = 1; g < height; g++) {
    const prev = rows[g - 1];
    const next = new Uint8Array(width);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const l = prev[(x - 1 + width) % width];
      const c = prev[x];
      const r = prev[(x + 1) % width];
      next[x] = table[(l << 2) | (c << 1) | r];
    }
    rows.push(next);
  }
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) data.set(rows[g], g * width);
  return data;
}

// RGBA texture data for a square: rgb = white (tinted by material color), alpha = cell.
// offsetX: cells of pattern shift to the LEFT (wrapping around the width).
// offsetY: cells of pattern shift DOWNWARD (blank rows appear at the top).
export function makePatternData(rule, width, height, opts = {}) {
  const offsetX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.offsetX || 0));
  const offsetY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.offsetY || 0));
  const cells = simulateCA(rule, width, height);
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let g = 0; g < height; g++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const srcX = (x + offsetX) % width;        // pattern moved LEFT by offsetX cells
      const srcRow = g + offsetY;                  // pattern moved DOWN by offsetY rows
      const idx = g * width + x;
      const v = srcRow < height ? cells[srcRow * width + srcX] : 0;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 0] = 255;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 1] = 255;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 2] = 255;
      rgba[idx * 4 + 3] = v ? 255 : 0;
    }
  }
  return rgba;
}

/* ---------- MIDI CC mappings ---------- */

export const CC = {
  WIDTH: 7,
  SPEED: 10,
  BRIGHTNESS: 11,
  SIZE: 14,
  OFFSET_LEFT: 15,
  OFFSET_DOWN: 16,
  RULE_LOW: 17,
  RULE_REG: 18,
};

export const CC_DEFAULTS = {
  [CC.WIDTH]: 64,
  [CC.SPEED]: 64,
  [CC.BRIGHTNESS]: 64,
  [CC.SIZE]: 64,
  [CC.OFFSET_LEFT]: 0,
  [CC.OFFSET_DOWN]: 0,
  [CC.RULE_LOW]: 64,
  [CC.RULE_REG]: 0,
};

export const WIDTH_RANGE = [4, 96];
export const SPEED_RANGE = [0.25, 2.5];
export const BRIGHT_RANGE = [0.1, 2.0];
// Square size is expressed as a percentage of the screen's smaller dimension,
// so a 100% square is as big as the total screen, whatever the aspect ratio.
export const SIZE_RANGE = [4, 100];

export function ccWidthCells(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = WIDTH_RANGE;
  return Math.round(lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127));
}

export function ccSpeedMultiplier(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SPEED_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

export function ccBrightness(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = BRIGHT_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Linear mapping: CC 64 (mid) lands near the middle of the range.
export function ccSizePercent(v) {
  const [lo, hi] = SIZE_RANGE;
  return lo + (hi - lo) * (clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127);
}

// Offsets in cells: raw CC 0..127 maps linearly onto 0..maxCells.
export function ccOffsetCells(v, maxCells) {
  const t = clamp(v, 0, 127) / 127;
  return Math.round(t * Math.max(0, maxCells));
}

/* ---------- formula (rule) selection ---------- */

// Registers for CC 18 (formula selector).
export const RULE_REG = {
  RANGE_LOW: 0,   // CC 17 value is itself the rule (0-127)
  RANGE_HIGH: 1,  // 128 + CC 17 value (128-255)
  RANDOM: 2,      // each spawn picks a uniformly random rule 0..255
  EVEN: 3,        // even rules only: CC 17 value * 2 (0, 2, ... 254)
  ODD: 4,         // odd rules only: CC 17 value * 2 + 1 (1, 3, ... 255)
};

export const RULE_REG_LABELS = [
  '0-127',
  '128-255',
  'random',
  'even-only (0,2,…,254)',
  'odd-only (1,3,…,255)',
];

export function ruleRegister(v) {
  return clamp(Math.round(clamp(v, 0, 127)), 0, 4);
}

export function randomRule(rng = Math.random) {
  return Math.floor(rng() * 256);
}

// Resolve the current formula. `low` is the raw CC 17 value (0..127);
// `register` is CC 18 value (clamped to the 0..4 register). In RANDOM mode a
// fresh rule is rolled; other modes are deterministic.
export function selectRule(low, register, rng = Math.random) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(register);
  const l = clamp(low, 0, 127);
  switch (reg) {
    case RULE_REG.RANGE_LOW: return l;
    case RULE_REG.RANGE_HIGH: return Math.min(255, 128 + l);
    case RULE_REG.RANDOM: return randomRule(rng);
    case RULE_REG.EVEN: return l * 2;
    case RULE_REG.ODD: return l * 2 + 1;
    default: return l;
  }
}

export function ruleLabel(low, register) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(register);
  if (reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM) return 'random';
  return 'rule ' + selectRule(low, reg);
}

/* ---------- square spawning ---------- */

export function pitchToHue(note) {
  return ((note * 0.618034) % 1.0);
}

export function randomSquare(rng = Math.random, rule) {
  const axis = rng() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
  const sign = rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  return {
    axis,
    sign,
    horizontal: axis === 'x',
    baseSizeFactor: 0.8 + rng() * 0.4, // per-square size multiplier (0.80-1.20)
    baseVelocity: 28 + rng() * 55,
    rule: rule === undefined ? randomRule(rng) : rule,
  };
}

export function scaleSize(baseFactor, noteVelocity) {
  const vel = clamp(noteVelocity, 1, 127) / 127;
  return baseFactor * (0.7 + 0.5 * vel);
}


/* fade in / decay lifecycle */

// Held squares fade in over FADE_IN seconds, then stay at full intensity.
export function heldFadeIn(secondsSinceSpawn, fadeIn = 0.18) {
  return clamp(secondsSinceSpawn / fadeIn, 0, 1);
}

// Decaying squares (note-off arrived) fade out over fadeOut seconds.
export function decayAlpha(secondsSinceNoteOff, fadeOut = 1.3) {
  if (secondsSinceNoteOff < 0 || secondsSinceNoteOff >= fadeOut) return 0;
  return 1 - secondsSinceNoteOff / fadeOut;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

// Human-readable name for a formula register (0..4).
export function registerName(register) {
  const reg = ruleRegister(register);
  return RULE_REG_LABELS[reg] ?? 'unknown';
}

}

function destroySquare(s) {
  scene.remove(s.mesh);
  s.texture.dispose();
  s.material.dispose();
}

function refreshTextures() {
  const w = ccWidthCells(state.cc[CC.WIDTH]);
  const offX = ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_LEFT], w);
  const offY = ccOffsetCells(state.cc[CC.OFFSET_DOWN], TEXTURE_HEIGHT);
  const reg = ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG]);
  const rule = reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM ? null : selectRule(state.cc[CC.RULE_LOW], reg);
  for (const s of state.squares) {
    if (rule !== null) s.rule = rule; // in random mode each square keeps its own rule
    const oldTex = s.texture;
    s.texture = makePatternFor(s.rule, w, { offsetX: offX, offsetY: offY });
    s.material.uniforms.uPattern.value = s.texture;
    s.widthCells = w;
    s.offsetX = offX;
    s.offsetY = offY;
    oldTex.dispose();
  }
}

function clearSquares() {
  for (const s of state.squares) destroySquare(s);
  state.squares = [];
}

/* ---------- animation ---------- */
function animate(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.lastTime) / 1000);
  state.lastTime = now;

  if (state.dirtyTextures) {
    refreshTextures();
    state.dirtyTextures = false;
  }

  const speed = ccSpeedMultiplier(state.cc[CC.SPEED]);
  const bright = ccBrightness(state.cc[CC.BRIGHTNESS]);
  const sizePct = ccSizePercent(state.cc[CC.SIZE]);
  const minDim = Math.min(width, height);

  if (state.autoplay && now - state.lastSpawnAt > 600) {
    const sq = spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 100);
    if (sq) setTimeout(() => decaySquare(sq), 450);
    state.lastSpawnAt = now;
  }

  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.squares[i];
    const t = (now - s.spawnedAt) / 1000;

    // size: percent of the screen's smaller dimension (100% = as big as the screen)
    const pct = Math.min(100, sizePct * s.sizeFactor);
    const sz = pct / 100 * minDim;
    s.mesh.scale.set(sz, sz, 1);

    // drift + tile: a square exiting one side re-enters from the opposite side
    const half = sz / 2;
    const v = s.baseVelocity * speed;
    if (s.horizontal) {
      s.mesh.position.x += s.sign * v * dt;
      if (s.sign > 0 && s.mesh.position.x - half > width / 2) s.mesh.position.x = -width / 2 - half;
      else if (s.sign < 0 && s.mesh.position.x + half < -width / 2) s.mesh.position.x = width / 2 + half;
    } else {
      s.mesh.position.y += s.sign * v * dt;
      if (s.sign > 0 && s.mesh.position.y - half > height / 2) s.mesh.position.y = -height / 2 - half;
      else if (s.sign < 0 && s.mesh.position.y + half < -height / 2) s.mesh.position.y = height / 2 + half;
    }

    // fade in while held, fade out once note-off arrives
    let alpha;
    if (s.held) {
      alpha = heldFadeIn(t);
    } else {
      const tOff = (now - s.decayingAt) / 1000;
      alpha = decayAlpha(tOff);
      if (tOff >= 1.3) {
        destroySquare(s);
        state.squares.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
    }

    s.material.uniforms.uFade.value = alpha;
    s.material.uniforms.uIntensity.value = bright;
  }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

async function connectMidi() {
  try {
    midiAccess = await navigator.requestMIDIAccess({ sysex: false });
    midiAccess.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribeToMidiInputs();
    setMidiStatus('connected', midiAccess.inputs.size);
  } catch (err) {
    setMidiStatus('unavailable: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'not allowed'));
  }
}

function subscribeToMidiInputs() {
  if (!midiAccess) return;
  for (const input of midiAccess.inputs.values()) {
    if (subscribedInputs.has(input)) continue;
    input.onmidimessage = onMidiMessage;
    input.onstatechange = handleMidiStateChange;
    subscribedInputs.add(input);
  }
}

function handleMidiStateChange() {
  subscribeToMidiInputs();
  setMidiStatus(midiAccess && midiAccess.inputs.size > 0 ? 'connected' : 'no MIDI inputs', midiAccess ? midiAccess.inputs.size : 0);
}

function onMidiMessage(e) {
  const [status, d1, d2] = e.data;

  const channel = status & 0x0f;

  if (channel === 1) { // channel 2: intentionally idle for now
    setReadout('channel 2 event (idle)');
    return;
  }
  if (channel !== 0) return;

  if (cmd === 0x90 && d2 > 0) { // note on
    spawnNote(d1, d2);
  } else if (cmd === 0x80 || (cmd === 0x90 && d2 === 0)) { // note off (or velocity-0 note-on)

/* ---------- spawning ---------- */
function spawnNote(note, velocity) {
  const square = createSquare({ note, velocity });
  setReadout('note ' + note + ' (v' + velocity + ')');
  return square;
}

/* ---------- note-off / decay ---------- */
function decaySquare(sq, quiet = false) {
  if (!sq || !state.squares.includes(sq) || !sq.held) return;
  sq.held = false;
  sq.decayingAt = performance.now();
  if (!quiet && sq.note !== undefined) setReadout('note ' + sq.note + ' off');
}

function decayNote(note) {
  for (let i = state.squares.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const sq = state.squares[i];
    if (sq.note === note && sq.held) {
      decaySquare(sq);
      return;
    }
  }
}

function formulaMapped(low, reg) {
  return reg === RULE_REG.RANDOM ? 'random' : 'rule ' + selectRule(low, reg);
}

function wireSlider(slider, valueBox, ccEdit, formatter, opts = {}) {
  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const max = opts.max ?? 127;
    const v = clamp(parseInt(slider.value, 10) || 0, 0, max);
    state.cc[ccEdit] = v;
    if (opts.markDirty && opts.markDirty()) state.dirtyTextures = true;
    valueBox.textContent = v + ' (' + formatter(v) + ')';
    updateLiveReadout();
  });
}

const ruleMarkDirty = () => ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG]) !== RULE_REG.RANDOM;

  v => formulaMapped(v, ruleRegister(state.cc[CC.RULE_REG])), { markDirty: ruleMarkDirty });
wireSlider(ui.sliderReg, ui.regValue, CC.RULE_REG,
  v => registerName(ruleRegister(v)), { max: 4, markDirty: ruleMarkDirty });

ui.btnNote.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sq = spawnNote(pickRandomNote(), 90 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 38));
  if (sq) setTimeout(() => decaySquare(sq), 800);
});
ui.btnClear.addEventListener('click', () => { clearSquares(); setReadout('cleared'); });
ui.btnMidi.addEventListener('click', () => { connectMidi(); setReadout('connecting…'); });
ui.autoplay.addEventListener('change', () => { state.autoplay = ui.autoplay.checked; });
ui.blend.addEventListener('change', () => {
  state.blendMode = ui.blend.value;
  ui.blendValue.textContent = state.blendMode;
  applyBlending(state.blendMode);
  setReadout('blend: ' + state.blendMode);
});

ui.toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const hidden = ui.panel.classList.toggle('hidden');
  ui.toggle.textContent = hidden ? '◀ Show controls' : 'Hide controls';
});

window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
function onResize() {
  width = window.innerWidth;
  height = window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(width, height);
  camera.left = -width / 2; camera.right = width / 2;
  camera.top = height / 2; camera.bottom = -height / 2;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
  syncControlsFromState();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  connectMidi();
});
